description: This file groups functions for reading CSV files into arrays and matrices, including functions for loading CSV data into matrices, arrays, and spans, as well as handling byte order marks and caching CSV data.

classes.name: XYplain
classes.description: A simple struct holding vectors for x and y data points from CSV files.

methods.name: getFileContents
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string (not implemented).

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file's contents or data (not implemented).

methods.name: loadCSV_mat
methods.description: Loads CSV data into a fixed-size matrix.

methods.name: loadCSV_1col
methods.description: Loads CSV data with one column into an array.

methods.name: ignoreBOM
methods.description: Skips Byte Order Mark characters at the beginning of a file stream.

methods.name: loadCSV_2col
methods.description: Loads CSV data with two columns into two arrays or spans.

methods.name: loadCSV_Ncol
methods.description: Loads CSV data with multiple columns into a dynamic matrix.
